evidence_method: Read four preserved checkpoint files with torch.load(map_location='cpu', weights_only=True) in the original runtime; inspect optimizer step tensors and checkpoint counters without any optimizer or simulation step.

expected_step_basis.actor_steps: Use the observed actor update counter; the common KL stop can reduce actor updates and does not skip value epochs.
expected_step_basis.value_steps_explanation: 5250 behavior samples, minibatch size 256, four epochs: ceil(5250/256)*4 = 84.

interpretation.observed: The later ordinary and adjoint branches have optimizer ages inconsistent with their own recorded value-update counters and the required shared initialization.
interpretation.source_mechanism: The old load_state passed the shared CPU Adam state dictionaries directly to optimizer.load_state_dict. Optimizer tensors could share storage with the in-memory common template; earlier branch updates then changed the optimizer initialization seen by later branches. Default network load_state_dict copied network values, so matching network hashes did not detect this optimizer-state contamination.
interpretation.scope: Actual trajectories and costs remain preserved execution records. Cross-arm method rankings from the old suite do not satisfy the declared initialization contract and cannot establish a scientific positive or negative result for the candidate.
interpretation.independent_io_failure: The recorded BrokenPipeError is a separate transport/log-output failure. Resuming its saved checkpoint and random stream did not remove the optimizer contamination already present.
interpretation.actor_state_boundary: The common actor optimizer was empty. The checked ordinary and adjoint actor step values match their own recorded update counters; this does not repair contamination of f/g/V.

required_rerun_initialization_checks.state_isolation: Every loaded branch must have independent optimizer tensor storage from both the common template and other branches.
required_rerun_initialization_checks.identity: All branches of the same seed must begin with matching network and optimizer contents. Preserve the original configuration hash; record the repaired source commit separately.
required_rerun_initialization_checks.mutation_test: A small isolated optimizer-state test may update one toy branch and must leave the common template and another loaded branch unchanged; this is not robot training.
